conventions.darkMode: body[data-ds-dark-theme] is the only palette switch. html carries color-scheme and data-ds-theme-source; the presenter writes inline --dsw-* overrides on body after the stylesheet values.
conventions.thirdPartyExtension: The supported override seam is ctx.theme.register({id, colorScheme, tokens}) / ctx.theme.overrideTokens(source, tokens) with {light,dark} pairs — not DOM attribute writes. See @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-theme/lib/client.js:1339-1520.

provenanceLegend.documented: Named in a shipped package README (source cited).
provenanceLegend.observed-only: Present only in compiled CSS/JS; no README contract, may change without notice.

bodyAttributes.name: data-ds-dark-theme
bodyAttributes.values: present (empty string) = dark palette; absent = light palette
bodyAttributes.notes: Single switch for the whole dark palette: every dark token declaration is scoped to body[data-ds-dark-theme]. Written before first paint by the injected body script and afterwards by the layout presenter; a theme plugin must not toggle it itself.

elementAttributes.name: data-platform
elementAttributes.values: darwin (only value observed in shipped CSS)
elementAttributes.owner: Electron/desktop preload (not set by web packages)
elementAttributes.notes: macOS desktop chrome branch: collapsed sidebar hides the column, leading seat clearance, 52px sidebar top strip. Third-party plugins may branch on it, but must keep the light/dark palette independent.

elementAttributes.name: data-windows-titlebar
elementAttributes.notes: Reserves the caption strip above all columns, publishes --dsh-windows-titlebar-height / --dsh-windows-content-radius / --dsh-windows-sidebar-width, and removes the collapsed rail.

elementAttributes.name: data-ds-theme-source
elementAttributes.notes: Resolved palette source for host shells: the Electron preload mirrors it into nativeTheme.themeSource. Value is "system" only while the preference is system, otherwise the resolved scheme. Not mentioned in any README.

elementAttributes.name: data-input-modality
elementAttributes.notes: Focus-ring visibility switch: html[data-input-modality=pointer] body :focus-visible:not(:read-write) makes the ring transparent. A theme that paints focus rings must respect it.

elementAttributes.name: data-fullscreen
elementAttributes.owner: desktop shell (no writer in the installed web packages)
elementAttributes.notes: Native fullscreen: frame overlay top drops to 20px, leading clearance 84px, sidebar top strip left-aligns.

elementAttributes.name: data-window-drag
elementAttributes.notes: ui-web base.css turns this mark into the single darwin -webkit-app-region: drag rule, so the marked row own box is the draggable geometry. New chrome rows in a theme should carry it.

elementAttributes.name: data-sidebar-collapsed
elementAttributes.values: true when collapsed; attribute omitted otherwise
elementAttributes.notes: Carries layout state, not only styling: ui-sidebar queries html[data-windows-titlebar]:has([data-sidebar-collapsed=true]) to shift --dsh-windows-menu-start. Value is the literal string "true".

elementAttributes.name: data-rightbar-collapsed
elementAttributes.values: true when the right column width is 0
elementAttributes.notes: Set when cols.rightbar === 0 (closed or fullscreen with no track).

elementAttributes.name: data-rightbar-fullscreen
elementAttributes.values: true while the right panel covers the viewport
elementAttributes.notes: Suppresses grid/handle transitions; pairs with data-sidebar-right-panel="fullscreen" on the panel itself.

elementAttributes.name: data-animating
elementAttributes.values: true while a discrete open/close animates
elementAttributes.notes: Track transition and occupant slide share --ds-transition-duration-slow / --ds-ease-in-out only while this marker is present.

elementAttributes.name: data-dragging
elementAttributes.element: frame element and conversation width handle
elementAttributes.notes: Disables transitions during column/panel drags; raises the handle (z-index 8).

elementAttributes.name: data-shell-overlay
elementAttributes.notes: Full-viewport modal/menu layer above the frame (z-index 20), below menus/modals from primitives.

elementAttributes.name: data-shell-leading
elementAttributes.notes: MacOS-only seat beside the traffic lights; while mounted the frame publishes --dsh-frame-leading-clearance.

elementAttributes.name: data-menu-material
elementAttributes.notes: Theme CSS hooks the dark stroke rebind on it: body[data-ds-dark-theme] [data-menu-material] sets --dsw-elevation-stroke-color to border-l3. Menus also paint --dsw-menu-surface-fill and --dsw-menu-backdrop-filter.

elementAttributes.name: data-dsh-automatic-focus
elementAttributes.values: boolean marker (present while programmatic focus is active)
elementAttributes.notes: base.css suppresses only the outline for this marker; borders, shadows and error states stay intact.

layoutStateAttributes.name: data-sidebar-collapsed
layoutStateAttributes.values: true when collapsed; attribute omitted otherwise
layoutStateAttributes.notes: Carries layout state, not only styling: ui-sidebar queries html[data-windows-titlebar]:has([data-sidebar-collapsed=true]) to shift --dsh-windows-menu-start. Value is the literal string "true".

layoutStateAttributes.name: data-rightbar-collapsed

layoutStateAttributes.notes: Set when cols.rightbar === 0 (closed or fullscreen with no track).

layoutStateAttributes.name: data-rightbar-fullscreen

layoutStateAttributes.name: data-dragging

layoutStateAttributes.name: data-shell-overlay
layoutStateAttributes.notes: Full-viewport modal/menu layer above the frame (z-index 20), below menus/modals from primitives.

layoutStateAttributes.name: data-shell-leading

sidePanelStates.notes: The two presentations: push = the panel occupies the frame's right track and the conversation makes room; fullscreen = covers the viewport while the wide-screen columns stay underneath. Opened below 768px uses fullscreen automatically. The same element sets --dsh-sidebar-width (100vw when fullscreen).
Expansion state (the column is expanded and the panel is visible); drives the slide-in of dock content.
No room for the requested track; the occupant closes deterministically.
Value is the *next* presentation the button will switch to, not the current one.

sidePanelStates.element: dock host containers inside the right panel
sidePanelStates.notes: Dock = the split tree in the panel; float = independent floating panes. Floats reorder inside a fixed stacking layer (float layer 60 vs dock 10/40) and do not rise above menus.
Used by sidebar-right to resolve the focused pane (closest("[data-dockkit-pane], [data-dockkit-float]")). Also data-dockkit-pane-active / data-dockkit-float-active markers.

sidePanelStates.element: dock split columns, empty panes, dividers
sidePanelStates.notes: Windows fullscreen radius targets [data-dockkit-column="0"][data-dockkit-pane]; darwin strip inset targets [data-dockkit-host=dock][data-dockkit-column="0"|"1"].

zIndexLayers.layer: conversation composer with open trigger menu
menus / tooltips / hover cards / trigger menu
zIndexLayers.note: Hardcoded in primitives, not a token.

rebindableVariables.name: --dsw-focus-ring-color
rebindableVariables.notes: Never declared globally: components rebind it per control (108 reads across shipped bundles). Light resolves to #4176E6 and dark to #7AAAFF through the fallback alias. In pointer modality the theme rule sets it to transparent; a theme must keep the fallback expression so rebinding still works.

rebindableVariables.name: --dsw-elevation-stroke-color
rebindableVariables.notes: Rebindable per elevated surface so the 0.5px hairline picks up the surface own border colour; dark menus rebind it to --dsw-alias-border-l3 under body[data-ds-dark-theme] [data-menu-material].

rebindableVariables.name: --dsw-menu-surface-fill
rebindableVariables.notes: Menu material contract: #f8f9fa94 light / #43454a73 dark (94%/45% alpha). Shared menus must keep it; --dsw-menu-backdrop-filter: blur(40px) saturate(150%) is applied by elevated surfaces that paint --dsw-specific-menu.

rebindableVariables.name: --dsw-hovercard-bg
rebindableVariables.notes: Gap: hover cards hardcode a dark fill in the component stylesheet, so they stay dark in light mode and ignore every palette token. A theme cannot fix this by overriding a token (the declaration is local); it needs a component-level override.

rebindableVariables.name: --dsh-menu-anchor
rebindableVariables.notes: Per-menu anchor custom property pair (--dsh-menu-<id>); positioning detail, not a theming hook.

notes: Only body[data-ds-dark-theme] is a stable, documented theming switch; everything else in layoutStateAttributes is an implementation detail of ui-layout.

Right-panel presentation is published twice: data-rightbar-fullscreen on the frame and data-sidebar-right-panel="push|fullscreen" on the panel. "dock" and "float" are dockkit hosts, not presentations.
The frame overlay layer (z-index 20) sits below primitives menus (100) and modals (1000), so a theme must not raise its own overlay above those without matching the primitive layers.
--dsh-scrollbar-* are the one family of hooks designed for rebinding from component CSS: an elevated surface rebinds thumb/hover to the l2 alias tokens and its own container width.
